definitions.gloss: analytical ability; analytical power; capacity for analysis
definitions.explanation: The ability to break down complex information, data, or problems into components and understand their relationships. Valued in academic, technical, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{解析力|かいせきりょく}に{優|すぐ}れている。
データ{解析力|かいせきりょく}は{現代|げんだい}のビジネスに{不可欠|ふかけつ}だ。
examples.english: Data analysis skills are essential in modern business.

examples.japanese: AIの{解析力|かいせきりょく}は{人間|にんげん}をはるかに{上回|うわまわ}る{分野|ぶんや}が{増|ふ}えてきた。
examples.english: The fields in which AI's analytical power far surpasses that of humans are increasing.

notes:
A compound of {解析|かいせき} (analysis) and {力|りょく} (power/ability). Used in academic, scientific, and business contexts to describe the capacity for detailed analysis.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {解析力|かいせきりょく}が{高|たか}い: to have strong analytical ability
- {解析力|かいせきりょく}を{高|たか}める: to improve analytical ability
- データ{解析力|かいせきりょく}: data analysis capability

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {分析力|ぶんせきりょく}: analytical ability — very similar; {分析|ぶんせき} is more common in everyday and business contexts, while {解析|かいせき} leans more technical/mathematical
- {洞察力|どうさつりょく}: insight, perceptiveness — the ability to see through to the essence of things
- {思考力|しこうりょく}: thinking ability — broader cognitive ability, not limited to analysis
